_comment: Write path: someone adds a memory. The SYSTEM finds candidate memories (voyage-3.5 -> $vectorSearch over the household's verified memories, all scopes -> rerank-2.5) and decides supersedes true/false per candidate. A supersede creates a pending override. Family members do not classify; they confirm or deny. expect.supersedes: keys the system must propose to replace (empty list = no override proposed). expect.not_supersedes: keys that may show up as candidates but must NOT be proposed.

cases.text: Physio is every second Tuesday now, not every week
The physio therapist's name is Priya
Ravi is coming at 11 tomorrow instead of 10, just this once
cases.note: A one-off exception doesn't replace the routine.

cases.text: Margaret takes her tea with honey now instead of sugar-free
Margaret enjoys jazz on the radio in the evening
cases.note: Different time of day, adds to the afternoon preference.

cases.text: The spare key is now kept in the mailbox
Margaret's favourite biscuits are ginger snaps
Anna's dinner tonight will be lasagna
cases.note: Adds detail to the same event, doesn't replace it.

cases.text: Anna is bringing dinner at 7pm today, not 6
Margaret is moving to assisted living next month
cases.note: The writer's own response must not reveal family-only memories, even as conflict candidates. Family members see the full picture during review.
